label:
Microparticulated
whey protein
step: heat and shear into tiny particles
note: About 1-1.3 kcal per gram against 9 for fat; it gels like egg white when cooked, so it goes into cold or lightly heated foods.

about.text: Whey protein concentrate heated in a controlled way so that the protein partly sets into a dispersion of microscopic particles. They feel creamy on the tongue and stand in for fat in ice cream, yoghurt, dressings and spreads.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

how.text: Heat partly coagulates the protein into a micro dispersion; the article gives no temperatures.
